selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: usb-storage not loaded, no prior blacklist config, pre-reboot boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: lsmod showed no usb_storage module loaded; no usb-storage entries existed in /etc/modprobe.d; captured pre-reboot boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e

selected_evidence.requirement: Blacklist configuration created to stop module loading now and after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf containing 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/false', confirmed file contents on disk
sudo modprobe usb-storage failed with exit code 1 ('could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument'); lsmod confirmed module remained unloaded

selected_evidence.requirement: Initramfs inspection to determine whether module blacklist needed embedding for early boot
selected_evidence.summary: Rebuilt initramfs and inspected its contents; confirmed usb-storage is not part of the hostonly-included module/config set, so the on-disk /etc/modprobe.d config (not initramfs) is what governs module loading on every boot of this host

selected_evidence.requirement: Single-node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged (connection terminated as expected); after polling, boot_id read as ea72b178-cd0b-4d90-adb9-c13dfaa3e2fc, differing from the pre-reboot dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e, proving the node actually restarted

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-reboot recovery and persistence of the blacklist ('after a reboot' requirement)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot: usb_storage still absent from lsmod, blacklist-usb-storage.conf still present with original contents, and sudo modprobe usb-storage still fails with the same install-command block, confirming the restriction survived the restart
